sentences.text: Handheld camera , shaky cam , queasy cam , queasicam , hand-held camera or free camera is a cinematographic technique where stable-image techniques are purposely dispensed with .	cinematographic	cinematographic	stable-image techniques	Image stabilization

The camera is held in the hand , or given the appearance of being hand-held , and in many cases shots are limited to what one photographer could have accomplished with one camera .	held in the hand	Hand-held camera	shots	Shot (filmmaking)

Shaky cam is often employed to give a film sequence an ad hoc , electronic news-gathering , or documentary film feel .	ad hoc	ad hoc	electronic news-gathering	electronic news-gathering	documentary film	documentary film
It suggests unprepared , unrehearsed filming of reality , and can provide a sense of dynamics , immersion , instability or nervousness .
The technique can be used to give a pseudo-documentary or cinéma vérité appearance to a film .	pseudo-documentary	pseudo-documentary	cinéma vérité	cinéma vérité
Too much shaky camera motion can make some viewers feel distracted , dizzy or sick .

causal_questions.question: Dizziness may be a result that viewers may experience from Shaky camera.
